dataset_type: SIMULATED BEHAVIOR EVALUATION FIXTURE - NOT FROM THE SERMON LIBRARY

cases.request: Find up to five self-contained clips in this video.
expected_invariants: Read every page until count reaches total.
Report complete coverage only after verifying order and timestamps.
Do not replace coverage with top-k search hits.

cases.request: Find a clip about sincerity in worship.

fixture_transcript.lead_text: A speaker discusses sincerity, then explains its limits in a neighboring passage.

expected_invariants: Search results are leads only.
Read neighboring context before scoring.
Preserve the stated qualification.

cases.request: Find an excellent segment that has never been used.
expected_invariants: Check proposal history.
Do not claim never used when publication history is absent.
State the reuse limitation.

cases.request: Select a short clip from this passage.

fixture_transcript.before: Do not judge the whole matter from one action.
fixture_transcript.candidate: It is not proof that the person is insincere.
fixture_transcript.after: The speaker then gives a separate example.

expected_invariants: Keep the word 'not' in the excerpt.
Do not turn the sentence into an affirmative claim.
Avoid combining the separate example without editorial reason.

cases.request: Propose the strongest line as a hook.

fixture_transcript.after: The speaker attributes and explains the narration.

expected_invariants: Keep attribution clear.
Do not present the quoted narration as the speaker's own words.
Flag the religious reference for human verification.

cases.request: Use the opening sentence as a clip.

fixture_transcript.after: The speaker immediately rejects the proposition.

expected_invariants: Reject a cut that makes the rejected proposition look endorsed.
A high editorial score cannot bypass the context gate.

cases.request: Find a clip about a topic absent from the simulated source.
expected_invariants: Return zero candidates.
Do not invent content to meet the requested count.

cases.request: Return several ranked clips from this video.
expected_invariants: Treat A and B as an overlapping duplicate unless a distinct message is evidenced.
Keep C only after independent context validation.
